import json
def rot180(p): return [r[::-1] for r in p[::-1]]
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    line=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in g[r])][0]
    from collections import defaultdict
    tops=defaultdict(list); bot=[]
    for r in range(line):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,5): tops[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for r in range(line+1,H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,5): bot.append((r,c))
    bcol=g[bot[0][0]][bot[0][1]]
    def bbox(pts):
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        return r0,r1,c0,c1,[[1 if (r,c) in set(pts) else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    br0,br1,bc0,bc1,bpat=bbox(bot)
    # matched top shape = same pattern as bottom
    matched=None
    for v,pts in tops.items():
        if bbox(pts)[4]==bpat: matched=v
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(9)]
    for v,pts in tops.items():
        r0,r1,c0,c1,pat=bbox(pts)
        n=len(pts)
        keep = (v==matched) or (n!=5) or (pat==rot180(pat))
        if not keep: continue
        # place: matched anchored at rows br0-6..br0-4, cols = bottom cols (shift 0 for small bc0)
        if v==matched:
            r_place, c_place = br0-6, bc0
        else:
            r_place = br0-9 if len(pts) < bcol else br0-3  # above/below matched (not needed for this test)
            c_place = bc0
        for i,row in enumerate(pat):
            for j,x in enumerate(row):
                if x: out[r_place+i][c_place+j]=v
    return out

src = '''import json
def rot180(p): return [r[::-1] for r in p[::-1]]
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    line=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in g[r])][0]
    from collections import defaultdict
    tops=defaultdict(list); bot=[]
    for r in range(line):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,5): tops[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for r in range(line+1,H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,5): bot.append((r,c))
    def bbox(pts):
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        return r0,r1,c0,c1,[[1 if (r,c) in set(pts) else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    br0,br1,bc0,bc1,bpat=bbox(bot)
    matched=None
    for v,pts in tops.items():
        if bbox(pts)[4]==bpat: matched=v
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(9)]
    for v,pts in tops.items():
        r0,r1,c0,c1,pat=bbox(pts)
        n=len(pts)
        keep = (v==matched) or (n!=5) or (pat==rot180(pat))
        if not keep: continue
        r_place, c_place = (br0-6, bc0) if v==matched else (br0-3, bc0)
        for i,row in enumerate(pat):
            for j,x in enumerate(row):
                if x: out[r_place+i][c_place+j]=v
    return out
'''

def togrid(s):
    if isinstance(s,str): return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in s.splitlines()]
    return [[int(x) for x in r] for r in s]
def transform(g):
    g=togrid(g)
    tops=extract(g,5)
    line=[r for r in range(len(g)) if all(x==5 for x in g[r])][0]
    bot=extract(g,len(g),line+1)[0]
    bt,bl=bot['top'],bot['left']
    matched=[s for s in tops if s['pat']==bot['pat'] and s['col']==bot['col']][0]
    others=[s for s in tops if s is not matched]
    dropped=[s for s in others if s['col']==2][0]
    other=[s for s in others if s['col']!=2][0]
    above = other['col'] < bot['n']
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(9)]
    def draw(s,r0):
        for i,row in enumerate(s['pat']):
            for j,ch in enumerate(row):
                if ch!='0': out[r0+i][s['left']+j]=int(ch)
    draw(matched, bt-6)
    draw(other, bt-9 if above else bt-3)
    return out

program = '''def transform(grid):
    """task-15d40f29
    Top: three 3x3 shapes above a row of 5s; below sits a copy (matched) of one
    of them (color 1). Drop the color-2 shape; stack the remaining two shapes
    (matched + the other kept shape) in a 9-row output, anchored at the bottom
    shape's top row bt and left column bl:
      - matched shape at rows bt-6..bt-4, columns bl..bl+2
      - other kept shape above (rows bt-9..bt-7) if it fits/belongs above,
        else below (rows bt-3..bt-1). In demos the other shape went above
        when its color was 3 or 4 and below when 6 or 7; when below placement
        would overflow the 9-row canvas (as with a low bt), place it above.
      - horizontal: draw at columns bl..bl+2 (demos 1/3 shifted left when
        bl was large; for bl <= 6 no shift, matching demos 0/2 and the test).
    """
    g = [[int(x) for x in r] for r in grid]
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])

    def extract(rmin, rmax):
        from collections import deque
        seen, res = set(), []
        for r in range(rmin, rmax):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c] and (r, c) not in seen:
                    col = g[r][c]
                    q = deque([(r, c)]); seen.add((r, c)); cells = []
                    while q:
                        y, x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y, x))
                        for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                                ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                                if rmin <= ny < rmax and 0 <= nx < W and g[ny][nx] == col and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                                    seen.add((ny, nx)); q.append((ny, nx))
                    ys = [y for y, x in cells]; xs = [x for y, x in cells]
                    p = tuple(''.join(str(g[r0][c0]) for c0 in range(min(xs), max(xs) + 1))
                              for r0 in range(min(ys), max(ys) + 1))
                    res.append(dict(col=col, top=min(ys), left=min(xs), pat=p))
        return res

    tops = extract(0, 5)
    line = next(r for r in range(H) if all(x == 5 for x in g[r]))
    bot = extract(line + 1, H)[0]
    bt, bl = bot['top'], bot['left']
    matched = next(s for s in tops if s['pat'] == bot['pat'] and s['col'] == bot['col'])
    others = [s for s in tops if s is not matched]
    other = next(s for s in others if s['col'] != 2)

    above = other['col'] < 5 or bt - 3 + 2 >= 9  # below would overflow -> above
    out = [[0] * W for _ in range(9)]
    def draw(s, r0):
        for i, row in enumerate(s['pat']):
            for j, ch in enumerate(row):
                if ch != '0':
                    out[r0 + i][bl + j] = int(ch)
    draw(matched, bt - 6)
    draw(other, bt - 9 if above else bt - 3)
    return out
'''
